evals.prompt: Review our 2027 mobile app strategy: 'Grow active users by 20%. Launch crypto staking, a new dashboard, dark mode and a referral program.'
evals.expected_output: A review stating the text is a goal plus a feature list with no diagnosis, guiding policy or target segment; a findings table; and a rebuilt skeleton with diagnosis placeholders labelled [Assumption], bets and a not-doing list.
assertions: The review identifies the missing diagnosis
The four features are treated as candidate actions, not strategy
A not-doing list or forced ranking is proposed
